description: This Java source file defines the SensorDeviceShell class, which provides shell commands for managing sensor devices in a mock Zigbee environment. It includes commands to list sensors, add legacy or standard sensors, manipulate their fault, tamper, low battery states, and trigger check-in events.

classes.name: SensorDeviceShell
classes.description: Provides shell commands to list, add, and manipulate sensor devices in a mock Zigbee environment.

classes.name: SensorDeviceShell.NameValueProvider
classes.description: A nested class extending DeviceNameProvider to supply sensor device names for shell command options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all sensors with their details in a tabular format.

methods.name: addSensor
methods.description: Adds a new standard sensor, with an auto-incremented default name if none specified.

methods.name: addLegacySensor
methods.description: Adds a new legacy door/window sensor, with an auto-incremented default name if none specified.

methods.name: fault
methods.description: Sets the specified sensor's faulted state to true.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Resets the specified sensor's faulted state to false.

methods.name: faultToggle
methods.description: Toggles the faulted state of the specified sensor.

methods.name: tamper
methods.description: Sets the specified sensor's tampered state to true.

methods.name: tamperRestore
methods.description: Resets the specified sensor's tampered state to false.

methods.name: tamperToggle
methods.description: Toggles the tampered state of the specified sensor.

methods.name: lowBattery
methods.description: Sets the specified sensor's low battery status to true.

methods.name: lowBatteryRestore
methods.description: Resets the low battery status of the specified sensor to false.

methods.name: lowBatteryToggle
methods.description: Toggles the low battery status of the specified sensor.

methods.name: sendCheckin
methods.description: Triggers a poll control check-in (report) from the specified sensor if supported.
